name: Grant Scheme for Cultivation of Aromatic Plants - Centre for Aromatic Plants
benefit:
- Under this scheme, the maximum grant limit for any individual farmer shall be ₹1.00 lakh or the grant amount admissible for the cultivation of up to 2 hectares of land (based on the survival rate of plants), whichever is less. 
  - The grant is provided for the cultivation of nine selected aromatic crops, namely aromatic grasses (lemongrass, citronella, palmarosa, khus, etc.), damask rose, mint
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a farmer. - The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years. - The nine selected species eligible for the grant must have been cultivated by the farmer at their own expense.
